glosses: To take for granted; to conclude, with less than absolute supporting data; to believe.

examples.text: I suppose we all agree that this is the best solution.
I won't be back before midday, I don't suppose.
I don't suppose you could lend me a euro, could you?
We're a place setting short, there'll be four of us - always supposing your sis really comes.
Mum, can go to the park yet? ~ Suppose you did your homework first.

Suppose that A implies B and B implies C. Then A implies C.

glosses: To imagine; to believe; to receive as true.

examples.text: How easy is a bush supposed a bear!
Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men, the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead.

glosses: To reckon to be, to account or esteem as.

examples.text:
[He] keeps you from the honors of a Queene,
Being ſuppoſde his worthleſſe Concubine.

glosses: To require to exist or to be true; to imply by the laws of thought or of nature.

examples.text: Purpose supposes foresight.
One falsehood always supposes another, and renders all you can say suspected.

glosses: To put by fraud in the place of another; to substitute fraudulently.

examples.text: A Water-monster, called the Nickard, does enter by night the chamber, where a woman is brought to bed, and stealeth when they are all sleeping, the new-born child and supposeth another in its place, which child growing up is like a monster and commonly dumb.

glosses: Dar por verdadero a partir de indicios o inferencias.

examples.text: Suponemos que está en casa, porque dijo que iría allí cuando salió.

glosses: Dar fingidamente por verdadero algo, poner en el caso de que fuera cierto, como premisa para otra cosa.

examples.text: Suponiendo que venga hoy, podremos salir mañana.

glosses: Necesitar algo para que cierta tarea o idea pueda ser verdad o efectuarse.

examples.text: Obtener un título limpiamente supone considerable esfuerzo.

glosses: Tener mucha importancia, significar mucho para alguien.

examples.text: Este premio supone mucho para mí.

glosses: Tener poder, autoridad o representación en un gobierno o comunidad.
